svg.aria-label: Diagram of the banking pack's record types. Four structured types across the top: customer carrying person name, national identity number, date of birth, email, phone and address; account, one to three per customer, carrying an IBAN and a balance in kurus; card, zero to two per account, carrying an always-masked card number; and transaction, many per account, carrying an IBAN, an organization and a short document field. Three document types below, drawn in red because each produces a label sidecar: complaint ticket of eighty to two hundred words, KYC note which is the pack's main tax number surface, and support transcript with alternating turns whose partial identifiers are labeled with their parent label.
svg.title: What the banking pack emits
svg.desc: Four structured record types and three document types, with cardinalities stated on each card.
